$comment: This manifest is the single source of truth for uAgents8's template catalog and the Configure step's env-var form. Keep this file and the platform's catalog in sync by hand - there is no shared-schema generation step yet.
name: LangGraph starter
description: A LangGraph graph with a calculator tool and a model node, behind FastAPI.

env_vars.label: LLM provider
env_vars.help_text: "openai" or "anthropic". Defaults to openai if unset.

env_vars.label: OpenAI API key
env_vars.help_text: Needed only when LLM_PROVIDER is "openai" (or by default). The template still starts and answers without it.

env_vars.label: Anthropic API key
env_vars.help_text: Needed only when LLM_PROVIDER is "anthropic". The template still starts and answers without it.

env_vars.label: Model name
env_vars.help_text: Optional override, e.g. gpt-4o-mini (OpenAI, default) or claude-3-5-haiku-latest (Anthropic, default).
